label: Controlled dependence laws, from the definitions (inference)
rule: A profile equal at the witness scenario cannot both favour and not favour; transport equalities along the control
meaning: Laws 1 and 2: the witness scenario agrees on the control (or the profile is fixed), so the profile favours x over y there too. Law 3 rewrites the profile by the tracked feature. Law 4: the witness scenario agrees on the control, so g's verdict there equals its positive verdict at s. Law 5 rewrites both sides by tracking. Law 6 rewrites both profiles. Law 7: Meets reads only Requirement, so the plan standard is unchanged by definitional unfolding. Law 8: the favouring verdicts read only the favouring of the actual content.
